simple.summary: חָרֵד (chârêd) means fearful ; also reverential First listed occurrence: 1Sam 4 13.

definitions.full: H2730. chared חָרֵד verbal adjective of foregoing, trembling ; — חָרֵד Judg 7:3 3 t.; חֲרֵדִים Isa 66:5 ; Ezra 10:3 — trembling (from fear), absolute Judg 7:3 (|| ירא ), 1Sam 4:13 (subject לִבּוֺ , followed by עַל , for , in behalf of); in awe and reverence, at word of God, sq, בְּ Ezra 9:4 ; Isa 66:2 (followed by עַל ), 66:5 (followed by אֶל ); compare ׳ח אל ׳בְּמִצְוַת Ezra 10:3 .
